title: Sorgenfrei-Scholarship 2026
summary: One-time financial grant for students at the University of Göttingen to cover study-related expenses.

degree_levels.notes: All regular students at the University of Göttingen who are enrolled in a degree program in the summer semester of 2026 and will graduate from Göttingen are eligible.

institutions.notes: Must be a student at the University of Göttingen.

application_rounds.notes: Interested applicants can apply until June 7 2026.
